claim: At N=128 (4 layers, d_model=64, 3000 steps, e<=0.5), the final force margin is in between the other arms in both seeds: 0.150 (seed 20, R2 0.642 vs control 0.492, layer 1) and 0.131 (seed 21, R2 0.603 vs 0.472, layer 1). That is below N=64 (0.21-0.26) and above N=256 (0.03-0.04), so force falls by roughly 0.1 per doubling of N, a gradual decline in log N. accel_step margins are 0.151/0.163 (R2 0.934/0.920 at layer 4, controls 0.783/0.757), with headroom-normalized margins of 0.70/0.67. The accel_step control did not fall from its N=64 level (0.77-0.79), and seed 20's 0.783 is just outside the predicted [0.66, 0.78] band.
confidence_note: The main force prediction holds in both seeds: final margins of 0.150 and 0.131 sit inside [0.08, 0.19] and clear of both falsifying bands. Normalized accel_step (0.70/0.67) is inside [0.62, 0.77]. The verdict is not 'supported' because one stated criterion fails narrowly: seed 20's accel_step control R2 is 0.7826, above the 0.78 upper bound. The hypothesis's mechanism also fails. It said the accel_step control would fall between N=64 and N=256 alongside force, but at N=128 the control (0.757-0.783) matches N=64, while force has already lost about 0.1 of margin. The force decline therefore does not move with the accel_step control. The force control (0.47-0.49) is also flat against N=64 (0.48-0.51) and N=256 (~0.5). Both runs are complete (3000/3000 steps) and beat the baseline (val_mse_ratio 0.069-0.071). Force had not levelled off at step 3000: it gained +0.006 (seed 20) and +0.004 (seed 21) over the last 500 steps. The N=128 value may therefore partly reflect slower force growth rather than a lower ceiling, and longer training could move it toward the N=64 band. Formation steps read from the trajectories match formed_at_step (force persistent from 1000 in seed 20 and 1500 in seed 21; accel_step from 500 in both). Seed 21's force best layer switched from 4 to 1 only at step 3000. Each arm has only 2 seeds and one data_seed. The verdict would become 'supported' if the band were judged at 2-decimal precision. It would become 'refuted' for the mechanism if added seeds kept the N=128 accel_step control at N=64 levels.
